description: The 'nonexistant_datasets' dataset provides a comprehensive overview of datasets that are managed within a specific system, focusing on their identification, management, and access parameters. Each entry in the dataset is uniquely identified by an 'id' and 'name', which are crucial for dataset management and reference. The 'projectKey' links datasets to specific projects, facilitating organized data management. The dataset includes metadata such as 'type', 'shortDesc', and 'description' to provide insights into the storage type, key features, and detailed purpose of each dataset. The 'exists' column indicates whether a dataset is currently available, while 'formatType' specifies the file format. Access details are provided through 'params.connection', 'params.mode', and 'params.path', which describe how and where the data can be accessed. Management and modification details are tracked with 'managed', 'creationTag.lastModifiedBy.login', and 'creationTag.lastModifiedOn'. Additional columns like 'tags', 'featureGroup', and 'num_metrics_checks' offer further categorization and quality insights. This dataset is essential for data administrators and analysts who need to manage, access, and analyze datasets efficiently, ensuring data integrity and accessibility.
shortDesc: Dataset management with identifiers, descriptions, and access details.

columns.name: id
columns.comment: Unique identifier for each dataset, crucial for management.

columns.name: name
columns.comment: Name of the dataset, used for identification and reference.

columns.name: projectKey
columns.comment: Project identifier, links datasets to specific projects.

columns.name: type
columns.comment: Storage type of the dataset, indicates data source.

columns.name: shortDesc
columns.comment: Brief description of the dataset, highlights key features.

columns.name: description
columns.comment: Detailed description of the dataset, explains its purpose and contents.

columns.name: exists
columns.comment: Indicates if the dataset currently exists, boolean value.

columns.name: formatType
columns.comment: File format of the dataset, such as CSV or Avro.

columns.name: params.connection
columns.comment: Connection parameters for accessing the dataset, specifies data source.

columns.name: managed
columns.comment: Indicates if the dataset is managed, boolean value.

columns.name: params.mode
columns.comment: Mode of the dataset, specifies how data is accessed.

columns.name: params.table
columns.comment: Table name in the database, used for data retrieval.

columns.name: params.schema
columns.comment: Schema of the dataset, defines data structure.

columns.name: params.path
columns.comment: File path for the dataset, indicates storage location.

columns.name: creationTag.lastModifiedBy.login
columns.comment: User who last modified the dataset, tracks changes.

columns.name: creationTag.lastModifiedOn
columns.comment: Timestamp of last modification, tracks dataset updates.

columns.name: versionTag.lastModifiedBy.login
columns.comment: User who last modified the dataset version, tracks version changes.

columns.name: versionTag.lastModifiedOn
columns.comment: Timestamp of last version modification, tracks version updates.

columns.name: params.metastoreDatabaseName
columns.comment: Name of the metastore database, used for data management.

columns.name: params.folderSmartId
columns.comment: Smart ID for the folder, used for organizing datasets.

columns.name: tags
columns.comment: Tags associated with the dataset, used for categorization.

columns.name: featureGroup
columns.comment: Indicates if the dataset is a feature group, boolean value.

columns.name: num_metrics_checks
columns.comment: Number of metric checks performed on the dataset, indicates data quality.

columns.name: num_columns
columns.comment: Number of columns in the dataset, indicates data complexity.

columns.name: column_names
columns.comment: Names of columns in the dataset, defines data structure.

columns.name: url
columns.comment: URL for accessing the dataset, used for exploration and analysis.
